sovereign_country.strategic_role: 连接拉美市场的欧洲商贸桥梁、本地化仓配与数字游民签证

business_scope.primary_industry_name: Manufacture of Turbine-Driven Critical Care Invasive Ventilators

ubo_and_aml_profiling.statutory_law_governance: Ley 10/2010, de 28 de abril, de prevención del blanqueo de capitales y de la financiación del terrorismo, as amended; Real Decreto 304/2014, de 5 de mayo, por el que se aprueba el Reglamento de la Ley 10/2010; Real Decreto 165/2019, de 22 de marzo, por el que se regulan los procedimientos de identificación y control de los titulares reales; Real Decreto Legislativo 1/2010, de 2 de julio (Ley de Sociedades de Capital).

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certificate of corporate existence and good standing of the direct corporate shareholder and its parent (if applicable)
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Commercial registry or equivalent company registrar in the country of origin

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Power of attorney granted by all incorporating shareholders to the Spanish incorporation counsel/representative
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Notary public in the country of origin

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certified extract of the shareholders' resolution approving incorporation, capital subscription, appointment of directors and UBO disclosure
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Corporate secretary of the shareholder or public notary in the country of origin

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certified copies of passports / national identification documents of all beneficial owners
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Notary public or competent registrar in the jurisdiction of origin

ubo_and_aml_profiling.pep_and_sanctions_screening_protocols: Mandatory screening of all shareholders, directors, officers and beneficial owners against the SEPBLAC national PEP lists, EU consolidated financial sanctions list, UN Security Council sanctions, OFAC SDN list and Spanish criminal/registry databases before incorporation. Because the venture serves government LC and SWIFT/Wire payment rails and manufactures life-support equipment, enhanced due diligence is required for any politically exposed person, government-controlled entity, or high-risk third-country resident. Findings must be documented in a compliance memorandum and made available to notary, bank, and AEMPS on request.

statutory_name_clearance_protocol.registry_portal_name: Registro Mercantil Central (RMC) – Sede Electrónica / online denominación social application (www.rmc.es)
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.language_and_transliteration_doctrine: The chosen name must be in Latin script; Spanish and co-official languages (Catalan, Galician and Basque) are acceptable. If a non-Latin source name is used, a Latin-character transliteration must be filed together with a sworn Spanish translation. The legal form suffix 'Sociedad de Responsabilidad Limitada' or 'S.L.' must be included. The name must not be identical or confusingly similar to existing registered names and must not infringe trademarks.
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.extension_and_rejection_appeal_sop: If the RMC rejects the proposed name, the applicant may within one month file an administrative appeal (recurso de alzada) with the Dirección General de Seguridad Jurídica y Fe Pública (DGSJFP) of the Ministry of Justice, or choose to file a new name application with different distinctive tokens. The RMC rejection notice will state the conflicting registered name or prohibited term. The certificate of non-registration is valid for 180 days; it may be renewed after expiry by a brand-new application only if no conflicting name has been registered in the interim. The appeal should annex the original rejection, the proposed corporate object, and any trademark priority evidence.

registered_office_and_commercial_substan.virtual_office_permissibility: A virtual office address is structurally acceptable for the constitutional domicilio social if a Spanish registered address is maintained and a physical mailbox or authorised agent is in place. However, for a manufacturer of ICU mechanical ventilators under ISIC 3250 / EU MDR 2017/745, a purely virtual office is not sufficient commercial substance. A physical registered office/facility in Spain is required for the AEMPS manufacturing licence, internal production or quality-control records, and traceability of life-support devices. The competent health authority and notified body will inspect the actual site; therefore, a lease or ownership of suitable premises is a practical prerequisite.
registered_office_and_commercial_substan.physical_inspection_likelihood: High: approximately 95% probability of an on-site pre-licensing audit by AEMPS or the notified body, and a further elevated likelihood of unannounced surveillance visits after CE marking under EU MDR/ISO 13485; the risk is increased by use of government letters of credit and the public health mission of the product.

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Spanish name clearance certificate (certificación de denominación social) – single non-conflicting name application
Sworn Spanish translations of foreign incorporation resolutions, powers of attorney, apostilles and identification documents
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Prevailing market benchmark per translated page

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Notarial execution of the public incorporation deed (escritura de constitución) including statutes
Provisional registration of the SL in the Registro Mercantil Provincial and filing of the incorporation deed
AML/CFT enhanced due diligence package: UBO piercing, PEP/sanctions screening, risk rating and compliance memorandum
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: External counsel and compliance database provider
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Market benchmark fixed fee per UBO and screening round

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Pre-incorporation corporate and regulatory legal opinion for ISIC 3250 / EU MDR requirements and government LC payment rails
Apostille or consular legalization of foreign shareholder and beneficial-owner documents (estimated for 4 sets)
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Official consular fee plus authorized courier

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Spanish criminal record certificates for directors and UBOs (certificado de antecedentes penales)

incorporation_legal_framework.governing_statute_and_sections: Ley de Sociedades de Capital (Royal Legislative Decree 1/2010 of 2 July), Articles 4-9, 21-27, 33-61, and 78; Commercial Registry Regulations (Royal Decree 1784/1996), as amended.
incorporation_legal_framework.competent_registry_authority: Registro Mercantil Central (for name certification) and Registro Mercantil Provincial of the corporate domicile (for registration of the deed of incorporation).
incorporation_legal_framework.statutory_filing_instrument: Public deed of incorporation (escritura de constitución) executed before a Spanish notary and registered in the Mercantile Registry.
incorporation_legal_framework.minimum_paid_up_capital_rule: EUR 3,000 minimum share capital for an Sociedad de Responsabilidad Limitada (SL), fully subscribed and paid in cash or in-kind before registration; cash contributions must be deposited in escrow in a Spanish credit institution and blocked for incorporation purposes until the Mercantile Registry issues the definitive registration.
incorporation_legal_framework.pro_forma_first_board_resolution_en: RESOLVED UNANIMOUSLY by the founding shareholders of [COMPANY NAME], S.L. (ES_SL): 1) The share subscriptions set out in the incorporation deed are approved, and the fully paid-up share capital of EUR 3,000 is acknowledged as deposited in escrow with a Spanish credit institution. 2) The registered office is fixed at [registered address], Madrid, Spain. 3) [Name] is appointed Sole Administrator (Administrador Único) and [Name] is appointed Secretary, with authority to act jointly and severally. 4) The directors are authorized to execute all filings with the Mercantile Registry, tax authorities, social security, and industrial licensing bodies.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Obtain a negative name certificate from the Central Commercial Registry
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Submit a request through the Central Registry's online portal or in person, proposing the company name and up to two alternative names. The Registry verifies that no identical or confusingly similar name exists and issues a certificación de denominación social valid for three months.
required_dossiers: Copy of the applicant's NIE or passport
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the name is rejected because of coincidence, file alternative names without additional fee or appeal the denial to the Registro Mercantil Central within one month, providing evidence that the conflicting name has lapsed or that the applicant has a legitimate prior right.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Open a blocked capital deposit account and deposit the statutory share capital
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Spanish credit institution selected by the founding shareholders
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Using the provisional NIF of the company in formation, open a temporary escrow account in the name of the company, deposit the full statutory capital of EUR 3,000, and obtain the bank's certificate of deposit confirming the funds are exclusively earmarked for incorporation.
required_dossiers: Draft NIE or ID of each founding shareholder
Copy of the proposed articles of association
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the bank requests additional economic capacity evidence, provide personal tax returns or corporate financial statements; alternatively, the notary may use its own legally recognized escrow account for the cash contribution and issue the deposit certificate.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Execute the public deed of incorporation before a notary
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Spanish notary (notario) with jurisdiction over the proposed registered office
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: The founding shareholders sign the public deed prepared by the notary, incorporating the approved by-laws, the capital deposit certificate, the name certificate, the appointment of directors, and the directors' acceptance declarations. The notary will provide certified copies and may electronically apply for the provisional corporate NIF.
required_dossiers: Identity documents of all shareholders and directors
Declaration of non-resident ownership, if applicable
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the notary identifies drafting defects or missing legal formalities, correct the deed using a rectification act or re-sign within ten business days, preserving the original deposit certificate validity.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Register the public deed in the Provincial Mercantile Registry
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Registro Mercantil Provincial where the registered office is located
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: File the notarized public deed (first copy) together with the statutory forms for registration. The Registry performs a formal legal examination (calificación) and issues the inscription of the SL, thereby granting legal personality and a unique Mercantile Registry registration number.
required_dossiers: First copy of the public deed of incorporation
Notary's proof of payment of notarial fees
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the Registry issues a suspension or negative qualification, remedy the specific defect and re-present the deed within legal deadlines; if the action is thought erroneous, appeal the qualification to the Dirección General de Seguridad Jurídica y Notariado.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Obtain the definitive corporate NIF and complete tax registration with the Spanish Tax Agency
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Submit the Mercantile Registry registration certificate and public deed to AEAT to convert the provisional NIF into the definitive corporate NIF. Complete the Form 036/037 census declaration, register for Corporate Income Tax, where applicable VAT, employer tax, and the place of business location.
required_dossiers: Definitive registration certificate from the Mercantile Registry
Certified copy of the public deed
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If AEAT delays or queries the application, correct the census declaration and resubmit; request a binding tax ruling (consulta vinculante) or file a grievance/solicitud de rectificación where the error is systemic.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Register the company as an employer with the Spanish Social Security Treasury and adopt occupational risk prevention clearance
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Tesorería General de la Seguridad Social (TGSS) and the autonomous-community or private occupational risk prevention service
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Open the employer's contribution code (código de cuenta de cotización) by submitting the company registration certificate and directors'/workers' identity documents. Simultaneously adopt a workplace risk prevention plan (PRL) and carry out the initial workplace risk evaluation.
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the TGSS office notes discrepancies in corporate data, resubmit the corrected documents or file an administrative appeal before the Provincial Directorate of the TGSS.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.competent_industrial_authority: Agencia Española de Medicamentos y Productos Sanitarios (AEMPS) and the Dirección General de Industria of the competent Comunidad Autónoma (e.g., Comunidad de Madrid, Cataluña, etc.).
industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.operating_license_title: Licencia de fabricación de productos sanitarios (medical device manufacturing authorization under EU Regulation 2017/745, transposed per Real Decreto 1591/2009) and municipal licencia de actividad for the industrial plant.

environmental_impact_assessment_eia.agency_name: Consejería de Medio Ambiente of the autonomous community / Ministry for the Ecological Transition and Demographic Challenge (MITERD)
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.classification_tier: Group 2 moderate industrial activity requiring a simplified environmental impact assessment or a recognized environmental license (licencia ambiental); a full EIA is mandatory only if the plant floor area exceeds 20,000 m² or if VOC emissions exceed the high-volume threshold under the Industrial Emissions Directive.
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.discharge_and_emissions_standards: Wastewater discharged to municipal sewer must meet local ordinance parameters of pH 6-9, COD below 1000 mg/L, and TSS below 500 mg/L; VOC emission concentration must remain below 50 mg C/Nm3, and all hazardous wastes (e.g., solvent-containing residues) must be segregated, labelled, and handled by a registered waste operator with quarterly manifests.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.civil_defense_and_occupational_clearance: Fire safety certificate (boletín de seguridad contra incendios) issued by the local fire brigade, structural load inspection certificate by a certified technical engineer before plant operation, and occupational risk prevention audit complying with Law 31/1995 (LPRL) covering emergency plans, first-aid provisions, and workplace hazard assessment.

national_tax_registration_infrastructure.competent_tax_authority: Agencia Estatal de Administración Tributaria (AEAT) — portal: sede.agenciatributaria.gob.es; local provincial AEAT offices handle certificates.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.tax_id_procurement_sop: Foreign shareholders must first obtain a Foreigner Identification Number (NIE). The Spanish SL is then incorporated by notarial deed, registered in the Registro Mercantil, and the company applies for a provisional NIF (Modelo 036/037) with AEAT; within 6 months the provisional NIF is converted into a definitive corporate NIF (CIF format: letter + 8 digits). Non-resident entities without permanent establishment must appoint a tax representative in Spain and register under Modelo 036 for non-established taxpayers.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.default_entity_tax_classification: Entity_Level_Taxation: The SL is a separate taxable person subject to Spanish Corporate Income Tax (Impuesto sobre Sociedades, IS) at 25% (15% reduced rate for new SLs during first two years of positive taxable base). Non-resident corporate shareholders are subject to Non-Resident Income Tax (IRNR) on distributions unless treaty-reduced. The SL is VAT-registered from first taxable transaction; no look-through treatment.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.statutory_election_mechanisms: No check-the-box election under Spanish law. Available elections: (1) Group taxation regime (Régimen de Consolidación Fiscal) for companies directly or indirectly held ≥75% by a parent, elected via Modelo 036 and binding for at least 3 years; (2) reduced 15% IS rate for newly created entities carrying on an economic activity; (3) optional territorial allocation for AEI/UTE structures (transparency of profits to members); (4) ATAD hybrid mismatch and interest limitation elections reported annually on Modelo 200 forms and computed under Law 27/2014 and Law 11/2021.

indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.indirect_tax_system_name: VAT (IVA — Impuesto sobre el Valor Añadido)
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.statutory_registration_threshold_local_c: No general VAT registration turnover threshold for established taxable persons; any economic activity in Spain triggers mandatory registration (Modelo 036). Non-established EU sellers must register in Spain when intra-EU distance sales exceed €10,000/year (unless using OSS); non-EU suppliers selling goods to consumers or providing digital services have zero threshold and must register directly via OSS or standard registration.
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.electronic_invoicing_and_clearance_manda: Real-time fiscal clearance applies via the SII (Suministro Inmediato de Información) for large taxpayers with turnover >€6M: VAT books must be transmitted electronically to AEAT within 4-8 days after issue/accrual (customs import invoices 8 days). The Ley Crea y Crece ('Veri*Factu') mandate requires all B2B taxpayers (phased from 2025) to issue invoices using certified billing software generating a QR code and continuous cryptographic hash chain, transmitted to AEAT through public APIs. Public-sector invoices must use the facturae XML 3.2 format via FACe portal. E-invoicing is the default for B2B; digital stamping via AEAT API is mandatory.

export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.zero_rating_eligibility: Exports of goods to third countries (outside EU, including Latin America) are exempt with credit (0% VAT) under Art. 21 of the Spanish VAT Law when: (a) goods are physically dispatched/transported out of EU within 90 days from delivery, (b) proof of departure is retained (DUA, B/L or AWB), and (c) the exporter holds valid customs export status. Intra-EU supplies of ventilators to EU-based hospitals are zero-rated under Art. 25 provided the buyer communicates a valid EU VAT ID and the goods are shipped to another Member State (recap statement on Modelo 349). Services directly related to exported goods (installation, calibration, commissioning of ICU ventilators) may be zero-rated as ancillary to the export.
mandatory_customs_documentation_bundle: Customs Export Declaration (DUA — Documento Único Administrativo) with AEAT customs exit stamp (case 'SALIDA') and EORI number
Bill of Lading or Air Waybill or CMR Road Consignment Note evidencing physical departure from the EU
Commercial Invoice and Packing List in English/Spanish matching the DUA
Inward Remittance Certificate: Bank SWIFT MT103 or proof of credit in a Spanish bank confirming external payment receipt
export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.audit_scrutiny_and_clawback_penalties: AEAT may retrospectively claw back zero-rated VAT and deny input VAT credits if the exporter cannot furnish the mandatory documentation bundle or if payment repatriation is not evidenced within the 180-day deadline (Banco de España foreign-exchange rules require declaration and repatriation of export collections). False claims or fraudulent false invoices trigger: penalty of 50%-150% of the tax amount (arts. 184-201 Ley General Tributaria), late-payment interest, and, in criminal tax fraud where the defrauded amount exceeds €120,000 per year, imprisonment and fines. Cross-border mismatch claims also face denial under ATAD hybrid rules plus 50% penalty.

fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.central_bank_authority: Banco de España (Bank of Spain), operating within the Eurosystem and the European System of Central Banks; monetary policy and euro exchange-rate policy are reserved to the European Central Bank, while the Bank of Spain supervises Spanish credit institutions, payment institutions, and the balance-of-payments statistical reporting regime.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.currency_convertibility_assessment: The euro is fully convertible for both current-account and capital-account transactions. Spain maintains no exchange-control authorization for trade settlements, capital injections, loan repayments, or profit remittances by non-resident shareholders, consistent with TFEU Articles 63-66. The only constraints are: (i) Bank of Spain balance-of-payments statistical declarations for individual external transactions equal to or exceeding EUR 50,000 or equivalent (Circular 4/2020); (ii) EU restrictive-measures and financial sanctions screening; and (iii) foreign-investment screening under Law 19/2003 and Royal Decree 571/2023 applicable to non-EU/EFTA investors acquiring control or critical thresholds in sectors affecting public health, security, or strategic assets, which may capture equity investment in a ventilator manufacturer. Non-resident shareholders may freely receive dividends and liquidation proceeds, subject only to general corporate income tax withholding and standard bank transfer documentation.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.export_proceeds_surrender_rules: None. Spain imposes no mandatory surrender, conversion, or repatriation requirement on export proceeds. Royal Decree 1816/1991 (régimen de transacciones económicas con el exterior) and EU free-movement-of-capital rules permit the SL to retain export receipts in EUR or in hard foreign currency in resident or non-resident accounts. The exporter must only ensure that its relationship bank files the balance-of-payments statistical declaration (F1 form) for each individual receipt of EUR 50,000 or above, including the ISIC 3250 merchandise-trade code for invasive critical-care ventilators, within the reporting deadlines of Banco de España Circular 4/2020.

tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.account_class: Government LC and Export Disbursement Account

corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.fintech_emi_cross_border_viability: Low-to-Medium for operational liquidity; not viable for escrow or government LC rails. PSD2-authorized electronic money institutions from other EEA states (e.g., Revolut through its Lithuanian license, Qonto through its French license) may passport into Spain without establishing a branch and can provide EUR IBANs, multicurrency wallets, and limited FX forwards. Spanish-authorized EMIs (e.g., Monei) are also available. Legal constraints: EMIs owe the same AML/CFT duties as banks under Law 10/2010, but funds held with an EMI are safeguarded, not covered by the Fondo de Garantía de Depósitos (EUR 100,000 deposit-guarantee scheme), and EMIs generally refuse Medium-Risk_Enhanced medical-hardware exporter onboarding, have low transaction-volume ceilings, and do not file the Bank of Spain external-transaction statistical forms as principal. Non-EEA 'offshore' digital banks (e.g., UK-licensed) cannot passport post-Brexit and are out of scope for a compliant treasury structure.
corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.physical_presence_and_kyc_interview_mand: Physical presence is the de facto mandate for the first signatory. Banco de España guidance permits remote biometric identification under Law 10/2010, but in practice Tier-1 banks (Santander, BBVA, CaixaBank) require an in-branch KYC and AML interview with the managing director and, for non-resident directors, a notarized and apostilled power of attorney (poder) granted to a Spanish-resident apoderado who must appear in person. Fully remote opening is not realistic for a newly formed SL in the Medium_Risk_Enhanced medical-device sector absent a pre-existing private-bank relationship. Spanish-language versions of all corporate documents and a sworn translation of non-Spanish resolutions are required.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Non-resident UBO chain with a Latin American intermediate holding company holding more than 25% of the SL, viewed as opaque ownership or potential tax-haven exposure.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Complete UBO chain schedule up to each natural person; apostilled company registry certificates from the intermediate holding's jurisdiction; OECD CRS self-certification and tax-residency certificates for each UBO; notarized deed of incorporation of the SL with registered bylaws; statutory declaration that no bearer shares, nominee shareholders, or discretionary trusts exist; and the compliance-mapped organizational chart with percentages.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: High-value exports of invasive ICU ventilation hardware to Latin American government ministries or public-health tenders, triggering enhanced scrutiny of trade-based money laundering and sanctions exposure.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: AEMPS certification as manufacturer/authorized representative for the ventilators; CE marking certificate and EU Declaration of Conformity under Regulation (EU) 2017/745; ISIC 3250 scope letter from the statutory auditor; executed government tender award letter or purchase order; UNSPSC commodity codes; end-user and no-re-export undertaking letters; commercial invoices with Incoterms 2020; customs export declarations from the Spanish Customs authorities; and a documented FATF-aligned risk rating of each public-sector buyer.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Politically Exposed Persons among shareholders or directors, triggering mandatory enhanced due diligence measures.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Signed PEP declaration forms for each director and UBO under Law 10/2010, Article 15; source-of-wealth and source-of-funds evidence (shareholder loan agreements, prior-year audited financial statements, notarized capital contribution deeds, and originating-bank statements for the contributed funds); a written capital-injection rationale memo; and a commitment to the 10-year document-retention obligation and ongoing transaction monitoring under Law 10/2010.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Material procurement from non-EU Asian OEM suppliers with invoices routed through third-country intermediaries, creating dual-use or export-control red flags.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Executed OEM supply agreements with legal-entity identifiers and upstream ownership declarations; export-control self-classification for ventilator subcomponents; customs power-of-attorney records; bills of lading and warehouse receipts demonstrating physical goods flow; AEO or ISO 13485 certifications where relevant; and a quarterly procurement-route audit trail prepared for bank compliance review on request.

cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.inbound_capital_injection_routing: EUR capital contributions are routed via SEPA Credit Transfer (ISO 20022 pacs.008) or SWIFT MT103 to the BBVA operational account, with the remittance reference stating the share-subscription resolution and notarial deed number; the bank certificate evidencing the deposit of subscription capital must be delivered to the notary before formal incorporation, and the deed must then be recorded in the Registro Mercantil for the SL to acquire legal personality. For non-EUR injections (USD, MXN, CLP), use SWIFT MT103 with a UETR, instructing charges 'SHA' or 'BEN' consistently with the account mandate; the receiving bank must match the funds to the Bank of Spain balance-of-payments declaration under the direct-investment purpose category. Any USD-to-EUR conversion executed by the bank must respect MiFID II/ESMA transparency rules and the Banco de España conduct-of-business requirements on FX margin disclosure to corporate clients.
cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.outbound_trade_disbursements: Primary rail is SWIFT MT103 for supplier payments, LatAm commission payments, and operational disbursements, each carrying structured remittance data (commercial invoice number, ISIC 3250 product description, customs declaration reference, and Incoterms 2020). For the target 'Government_LC' rail, incoming export payments are executed through confirmed irrevocable documentary letters of credit issued by Latin American state or development banks and advised via BBVA or Santander's correspondent network; the export presentation must include the AEMPS export declaration, commercial invoice in Spanish/English, pre-shipment inspection certificate, and full bill-of-lading set. For EU vendor settlements, use SEPA Credit Transfer and SEPA Direct Debit mandates; large-value euro clearing runs through T2 (TARGET Services) with IBAN-only routing and BIC validation. Bank-to-bank cover payments in USD use SWIFT MT202 COV. Documentary collections (DP/DA) are the accepted secondary rail for lower-rated public-sector buyers where an LC is not available.
permissible_fx_hedging_instruments: Outright EUR/USD and EUR/CLP forward contracts executed under a local CMOF (Contrato Marco de Operaciones Financieras) or ISDA master agreement, with tenors normally capped at 12 months for an unrated SL and EMIR/ESMA trade reporting obligations.

Non-deliverable forwards (NDFs) on EUR/MXN and EUR/CLP to hedge collection risk in Latin American currencies lacking a liquid deliverable market, settled in USD or EUR under a credit-support annex or initial margin.
EUR/USD and EUR/GBP foreign-exchange swaps (spot-start and forward-start) to match import-payable and export-receivable liquidity mismatches.

Cross-currency swaps (e.g., USD-EUR) for larger North American parent funding injections where intercompany debt is retained, documented under the CMOF or ISDA and subject to EMIR margin and clearing rules.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Accounts and Management Report (Cuentas Anuales e Informe de Gestión)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Mercantile Registry of the company's registered office (Registro Mercantil Provincial)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Shareholders' approval within 6 months of fiscal year-end; filing at the Mercantile Registry within 1 month after approval (i.e., by 31 July for calendar-year companies)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Fines from EUR 1,200 to EUR 6,000; the company is struck from certain registry effects ('cierre registral') and cannot file valid public documents or obtain certified registry certificates until accounts are filed; prolonged failure is an administrative strike-off trigger

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: State Tax Administration Agency (Agencia Estatal de Administración Tributaria - AEAT)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Within 25 calendar days following the 6-month period after fiscal year-end (i.e., by 25 July for calendar-year companies)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late-filing surcharge of 5% to 20% of the tax due depending on delay; default interest at the legal rate; penalties up to EUR 300 or 15% of the omitted tax base for inaccurate submissions; persistent non-filing is an enforcement strike-off factor

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Declaration of Ultimate Beneficial Owners and Shareholding Confirmation (Declaración Anual del Titular Real)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Annually concurrent with the filing of Annual Accounts; any shareholding transfer or UBO change must be declared within 30 calendar days of the event
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Administrative fines for late or incomplete filing; registry closure preventing valid corporate filings; potential criminal sanctions for willful false UBO statements

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Company Books Legalisation and Register Audit (Legalización de Libros y Auditoría Registral)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Annual books (Inventory and Annual Accounts Book, Journal) must be legalised at the Mercantile Registry within 4 months after year-end; registers of members, directors, and minutes must be continuously updated
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Non-legalised books lose evidentiary value at law; administrative penalties of EUR 1,200 to EUR 60,000 for failure to keep statutory books; risk of auditor adverse opinion and disqualification of directors

statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.compulsory_audit_thresholds: Mandatory independent audit if the company satisfies at least two of the following conditions for two consecutive fiscal years: total assets exceeding EUR 2,850,000; annual net turnover exceeding EUR 5,700,000; or average number of employees exceeding 50; obligatory audit also for companies that are parent entities in a group, listed, or where requested by 5% of shareholders or the Mercantile Registry
statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.governing_accounting_framework: Spanish Generally Accepted Accounting Principles (Plan General Contable - PGC) as implemented from EU Directive 2013/34/EU; the PGC de PYMES applies to small companies; IFRS-EU is mandatory for consolidated financial statements of listed groups and optional for individual accounts under limited circumstances

corporate_registers_and_ubo_annual_confi.ubo_annual_confirmation_protocol: The SL must file an annual UBO declaration (Declaración Anual del Titular Real) with the Mercantile Registry alongside the Annual Accounts, identifying each ultimate beneficial owner holding, directly or indirectly, more than 25% of the share capital or voting rights or exercising ultimate control; any change in ownership structure or substance-of-control must be updated on the statutory share register and declared to the Registry within 30 calendar days of the transfer
mandatory_on_site_statutory_registers: Register of Members (Libro Registro de Socios)
Register of Directors (Libro Registro de Órganos de Administración)
Inventory and Annual Accounts Book (Libro de Inventarios y Cuentas Anuales)

recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.registered_office_or_agent_market_range_: USD 400 - USD 1,800 per year for registered address, legal representation, and corporate secretarial services depending on Madrid vs. provincial location
recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.statutory_audit_estimated_fee_usd: USD 3,500 - USD 8,000 per year for a certified statutory audit performed by an INSO-registered auditor for a medium-sized ISO 13485 medical device manufacturing SL

corporate_income_tax_regime.effective_tax_rate_incentives: Reduced 15% rate for newly created SLs in the first two tax periods with a positive tax base (art. 29.3 LIS); tax credits for R&D&I (25%-42%), patent box regime (10% qualifying IP income), double taxation credits, and 10% capitalization reserve for retained earnings.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.form_identifier_and_portal: Modelo 200 – Annual Corporate Income Tax Return; filed electronically via AEAT Sede Electrónica (agenciatributaria.gob.es) using Cl@ve PIN, digital certificate or secure e-ID.
tax_return_filing_anatomy.statutory_deadline_rule: Within 25 calendar days after the expiration of six months following the end of the tax period; for calendar-year entities, the deadline is 25 July of the following year.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Resultado contable de la cuenta de pérdidas y ganancias – accounting profit/loss before tax under Spanish GAAP.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: The Spanish SL reports its full Spanish-activity result; non-resident ownership does not exempt it from filing.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Permanent and temporary adjustments to the accounting result: non-deductible expenses, amortization, provisions, valuation changes and related-party fair value adjustments.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Document any transfer-pricing adjustment on cross-border invoices or intercompany payments using the required Local File.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Resultado previo, compensation of prior negative tax bases and final base imponible (taxable income).
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Loss carryforward is indefinite; high-turnover entities face annual offset caps. Non-resident shareholders have no direct set-off rights.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Applicable tax rate (25% general; 15% reduced for new SLs) and cuota íntegra (gross tax before credits).
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Eligibility for the 15% new-company rate is unaffected by non-resident shareholding.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Bonificaciones, deductions for international double taxation and other tax credits, yielding cuota líquida.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Credits for foreign taxes paid generally require a valid certificate of tax residence from the source country.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Withholdings and payments on account, prior quarter instalments, and cuota diferencial a ingresar o devolver.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: The SL must account for Spanish withholding on dividends, interest or royalties paid to non-residents before computing the net balance.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.failure_penalties: Late filing triggers an extemporaneous surcharge of 5%–20% of the amount due depending on delay, plus late-payment interest (LGT art. 27). Failure to file is penalized with a fixed penalty (€200 where no tax is due; larger fixed penalty plus 5% where a tax amount exists) and, for inaccurate returns, a penalty of 50%–100% of the omitted tax (LGT art. 191).
